1037621.note: Pohang City has confirmed the 2026 festival for Nov 19–21 at Yeongildae Beach and Songdo Pier (moved from early summer because of the June local elections). Nov 19: a media-facade lighting ceremony at Songdo Pier and a citizens' fireworks show. Nov 20: the Asia DJ Festival and a Night Carnival. Nov 21: the International Fireworks Show with teams from France and Japan, followed by Korea's Grand Finale over Yeongildae Beach (an earlier report put the start at 8 pm). The city expects more than 150,000 visitors and will run AI crowd-monitoring cameras around Yeongildae Beach. Road closures and shuttle buses had not been announced as of Nov 11, 2026.

1244634.note: The 26th Masan Gagopa Chrysanthemum Festival runs Oct 31 – Nov 8, 2026, and admission is free. This year it spreads along the waterfront across three areas: 3·15 Marine Nuri Park (about 100,000 chrysanthemum pots), Happo Waterfront Park and Masan Marine New Town. Its signature piece is a single chrysanthemum plant trained to carry 1,540 blooms, a Guinness World Record. The opening night starts with fireworks, and on the evening of Nov 4 a nakhwa ('falling fire') show is held over the sea for the first time, with more than 1,500 hanging fire sticks burning for about an hour. Changwon City provides about 5,500 parking spaces across the three sites and a free shuttle from Masan Station, but the weekday shuttle stops at 6 pm.
1244634.noteFoot: Source: Maeil Shinmun, Oct 16, 2026. Checked Oct 21, 2026.
1244634.desc: Oct 31 – Nov 8, 2026 · Changwon (Masan). Free chrysanthemum festival on the waterfront; first nakhwa fire show over the sea Nov 4. Free shuttle from Masan Stn.
